package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
)

// A copy of C shares its map with the caller: the mirrored String callback
// would run against a rebuilt map, so reflect.ValueOf stays refused.
type C struct{ m map[string]int }

func (c C) String() string { return "c!" }

func main() {
	v := reflect.ValueOf(C{m: map[string]int{"a": 1}})
	fmt.Println(v.NumField())
}
